rationale: The body mentions the strawberry notch homolog in fruit flies as background on SBNO2. The human gene-network study assigns no strawberry ingredient or diet.
Strawberries contribute to modeled dietary contaminant estimates. Residue and dietary modeling are the exposures and no falls or Parkinson endpoint was assessed.
mStrawberry denotes a fluorescent protein construct in the VPS35 laboratory work. It is not a food treatment.

A plant pathology example explicitly includes strawberry challenged with fungi and reports no observed sulfur accumulation under the tested conditions. This review contains no human ingestion or falls comparison.
Strawberry-like describes gingival enlargement in a systemic disease vignette. The posted original has no strawberry ingestion comparison.
The primary horticultural study treats strawberry plants with foliar melatonin under aluminum stress and reports plant performance and fruit quality. No patient or dietary falls outcome is studied.
Strawberry is listed among food sources of lupeol. The mouse intervention uses the isolated compound and has no raw strawberry arm or clinical falls.

Rotenone-treated mice fed strawberry leaf extract had longer day-28 rotarod latency at high dose and shorter pole T-turn. The report has no edible raw fruit arm or spontaneous Parkinson fall frequency.
